name: Gentleman
description:
The Vibe: Clean, energetic, and highly sophisticated.

The Scent Journey: A lively introduction of bright citrus, juicy fruits, and fresh spicy notes creates an immediate wave of energy. The heart unfolds into a refined blend of aromatic lavender and clean herbal accords, which perfectly balances against a warm, comforting base of creamy vanilla and smooth woody notes.

Best For: A versatile, day-to-night scent that feels both fresh and reassuringly warm.
